resources.string: Advanced check of the complete Hour, Day and Month history. Use the normal update for routine synchronization. Full Re-Sync rereads the exposed archive from the beginning, keeps existing data, and can take as long as the first synchronization. Available after all three history baselines are complete.

This can take as long as the first history synchronization. Keep the phone on the same meter until the process finishes. Existing history is not deleted; matching periods are confirmed and differences remain preserved as revision or conflict evidence.
Complete the initial Hour, Day and Month history synchronization first.
Full Re-Sync is armed. Present the same meter again. Archive access starts only after its identity is verified.
Full Re-Sync is checking Hour, Day and Month. Keep the phone still; validated periods are saved immediately.
